{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float after removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders (not refunded)
completed_orders = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']
num_completed = len(completed_orders)

# Output the result
print(f'Number of completed orders (not refunded): {num_completed}')"}
